attributes.board_name: Colorado State Physical Therapy Board (DORA Division of Professions and Occupations)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Professional Development Activities (PDA; 1 PDA = 1 clock hour of 60 minutes) under the Board's Continuing Professional Development program: self-assessment, learning plan, then PDA relevant to the learning goals. At least 20 of 30 hours in Educational Coursework, Fellowships or Residencies (accredited college credit hour = 10 PDA, non-accredited = 5). Other categories: formalized assessments, presentations (first delivery), research, publications, mentoring, supervision, independent study, in-service, group study, volunteer service. No pre-approval of providers; all hours may be online. Alternatives: Deemed Status (CDE special services provider employed by a school district for the whole period) or pre-approved Military Exemption.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CPC requirements start after the first renewal; a PT first licensed in the current period needs no CPC for that renewal.
rules.audit_note: At renewal the licensee attests how CPC was met; compliance audits after each license period. Keep documentation (SAT, Learning Plan, certificates, forms) at least 5 years; do not send to the Board.
rules.legal_basis: C.R.S. §12-285-119; State Physical Therapy Board Rules 4 CCR 732-1
rules.notes: Two-year license period November 1 - October 31 of even years (current period ends October 31, 2026). Hours count for one period only; activities that are part of the primary job duties do not count.
rules.rule_quote: Physical Therapists must complete at least 30 PDA during each 2-year license period.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same CPD program as PTs (1 PDA = 1 clock hour); at least 15 of 20 hours in Educational Coursework, Fellowships or Residencies. Deemed Status and Military Exemption also available.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CPC requirements start after the first renewal of the initial PTA certification.
rules.audit_note: Attestation at renewal; audits after each certification period. Keep documentation at least 5 years.
rules.legal_basis: C.R.S. §12-285-209; State Physical Therapy Board Rules 4 CCR 732-1
rules.notes: Colorado certifies (not licenses) PTAs; 2-year certification period. Self-assessment, learning plan and PDA documentation as for PTs.
rules.rule_quote: Physical Therapist Assistants must complete at least 20 PDA during each 2-year certification period.
